diagnostics.message: google_monitoring_notification_channel.channels is created against the Cloud Monitoring API but has no dependency on google_project_service.project_services. When the project is newly created by this module, the monitoring.googleapis.com API activation runs asynchronously after project creation; without ordering, channel creation can race API enablement and fail (the sibling google_logging_project_sink.sink already carries exactly this depends_on).

google_monitoring_alert_policy.alerts is created against the Cloud Monitoring API but only depends on the notification channels (which are themselves unordered with respect to API activation). It needs a dependency on google_project_service.project_services so monitoring.googleapis.com is fully enabled before the alert policy is written, matching the ordering google_logging_project_sink.sink already has.

google_monitoring_monitored_project.primary attaches this project as a monitored project in a metrics scope via the Cloud Monitoring API, but has no dependency on google_project_service.project_services. On a freshly created project the monitoring API may still be activating when this resource is created, causing a spurious failure.

google_compute_project_default_network_tier.default_network_tier sets the project-wide Compute Engine default network tier via the Compute API, but has no dependency on google_project_service.project_services. The sibling resource google_compute_project_metadata_item.default depends on the service activation for the same compute.googleapis.com API; this resource should too, otherwise creation can race API enablement on a new project.
